stem: Trichome observations from a single top flower look more mature than samples from lower and interior flowers. What is the strongest harvest-readiness conclusion?
choices: The entire crop is ready because the top flower is ready
Representative sampling across meaningful canopy positions is needed because maturity can be heterogeneous
Harvest should always wait for a fixed amber percentage
Only calendar week should determine harvest
rationale: Cannabis trichome development can vary with genotype, age and position. Representative sampling is stronger than a universal color percentage or a single flower observation.
